question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the bracketed idiom in the given sentence.

She invited (all and sundry) to her party.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (4).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the idiom **'all and sundry'** is **'everyone without distinction'. **(हर कोई बिना किसी भेदभाव के)
 
• In this context **"all and sundry"** emphasizes that people from diverse backgrounds and age groups attended the party.
 
 
• **For example: **His achievements were recognized and celebrated by ***all and sundry***.
 
 
 
• The other options are not appropriate in this context.

*Therefore, the correct answer is **"Everyone without distinction".*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **"To take reckless risks":** To engage in dangerous actions without caution.(बिना सावधानी के खतरनाक कार्यों में संलग्न होना)
 
• **"To remove a misapprehension": **To correct a misunderstanding. (ग़लतफ़हमी सुधारें)
 
• **"To suffer humiliation": **To experience embarrassment or shame. (शर्मिंदगी या लज्जा का अनुभव करना)
